label: TP
reason: User input via getParameterNames flows directly to param, which is passed to Thing1.doSomething returning bar. The bar variable is concatenated into the SQL query string without any sanitization, reaching the JDBC template sink. Although ESAPI encoder is used elsewhere, it is applied to the result set loop and error message, not to the SQL query itself containing bar. The SQL query construction line uses concatenation (+), bypassing any potential encoding on bar.

evidence.note: User input flows through param to bar via doSomething and is concatenated into SQL query without sanitization
